notebooks.text:
Open technical verification items: sources for verbal changes; partial-log scan metadata/evidence; inventory date bounds and archived-partition search capability/resolver; `sensor-data` restriction owner, policy, audit, exceptions, repository and retention; restore-search index version, coverage, completeness and evidence; clock-epoch raw-time retention, late-upload mapping, synchronization/drift evidence, tests, applicability, owners and Systems Integration Team review; sequence-counter implementation, behavior, tests and alerts; event-correlation requirement citation, owner, repository and version; checkpoint validation, key management, rotation/revocation, fail-closed and rollback tests; retention/archive and clock-sync owners. Restore validation when audit head is unavailable/corrupt and restore-drill owner remain open. No named owner/artifact ID confirmed for log inventory bounds and archived search; restore-index details and documented SIT review not confirmed. District highway records do not establish audit-log signatures/certificates, backup repository management, inventory bounds, or various physical-security/facilities practices. Resident 4 cannot access the log platform from this room.

Clock-epoch requirements: retain raw timestamps plus epoch mapping, synchronization/drift measurements, late-upload tests, transition evidence, uncertainty bounds and mapping provenance. Treat events as unordered across unconstrained epochs unless causal evidence establishes order. Test an “unknown” indicator after reboot until fresh detector update, plus indicator/power-fallback behavior. Restore evidence should validate authenticated manifests/signed checkpoints and rollback detection; include key rotation/revocation and fail-closed behavior. No restore drill plan/record, named owner, or scheduled date found. Prior search scope: Jan. 1, 2022–present; project-management tools and meeting records; terms “restore drill,” “key rotation,” “revocation validation,” “rollback detection”; end time lacks concrete UTC timestamp/time zone. Reboot-test specification repository and revision ID remain unverified.

Village follow-ups: welcome map/pack, monthly newcomers’ tea, printed notices, accessible routes/toilets/seating, hall availability and weekday chat spots (unverified), bridge/orchard path checks, birdsong and wildflower guides, possible summer picnic, local growing/nature noticeboard section, litter-pick inquiry. Hall opening times and weekday availability need local confirmation. Shop and post office should each confirm hours; shared notice has separate sections and “last checked” dates. Noticeboard use tally suggested. Bridge path inspection after sufficient rain remains pending; note conditions/hazards and any safe alternative. Orchard stretch can hold water longer; check after rain and record clearance time. Pocket leaflet favored for walkers, with “last checked” date and rain caveat; noticeboard map useful before setting out. Check marker location and permission before installation. Bird calls locally confirmed, typical-month notes plus date/spot heard, not guarantees; include quiet-listening reminder. Resident 3 will ask wildlife group about suitable birdwatching spots and seasonal restrictions, check paths after rain, and ask about beekeeper/shared-plot contacts willing to be listed. Resident 2/4 have not heard back from walking group about volunteer to maintain welcome-map date. Ask parish/walking group whether regular litter picks already exist before suggesting one. Local growing/nature listing needs consent and named contact; Resident 4 offered to draft after Resident 3 finds an interested contact. Include offering, contact name, last-checked date.

Recent village status: no confirmed noticeboard listings yet with both a named contact and “last checked” date; actual board needs local check. No confirmed beekeeper yet; Resident 3 plans to ask. Pending map items may be listed as unconfirmed. Hall references/open days should await hall committee confirmation; map can direct newcomers to the noticeboard as a place to check for updates, without implying notices are current. Hedgerow manager/schedule unknown; ask parish office to identify landowner/lane manager and give estimates only with last-checked date. Walking group’s meeting spot, litter-pick activity and welcome-map volunteer remain unconfirmed. Quiet stone wall past orchard can be marked only after checking safe access; don’t claim accessibility unless verified. Resident 3 will check stone bridge and orchard together on next wet day and record conditions / orchard water-clearance time. Marker permission is pending: Resident 4 does not know parish clerk contact; parish office is starting point. Latest: Resident 4 has not contacted parish office yet, plans to ask for the clerk’s details and permission, and will report back. Resident 4 has not proposed a festival and is leaving that prompt aside. Avoid repeating prior replies unless there is a meaningful update.
